implementation.levels: 0..255 stock normal levels; 65 gamma rows plus per-level AID
implementation.calibration: Factory MTP read twice and checked; runtime C computes per-panel tables
implementation.sequence: HS AID, ACL averaging/start/percent, ELVSS, CAPS, gamma, final update key; cmd_lock spans the full tuple
implementation.screen_off: Full DRM/fbdev power cycle; brightness 0 means stock minimum 2 nit, not off. Manual bl_power blanking is rejected.
implementation.off_state: Cache requested brightness; apply before display-on during enable
implementation.write_failure: Return error; retain previous applied/requested driver state, send no update key after an earlier transfer error

host_validation.gamma_comparison: 65 rows x 33 bytes for actual tablet, zero and signed-offset fixtures; matches independently compiled Samsung C and Python reference
host_validation.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on gamma port
host_validation.tests: 4 test methods: original gamma fixtures, invalid VT rejection, stock mapping, full command sequence/fault injection/off-state caching
host_validation.builds: Kernel, module package and initramfs succeeded. Unused generated curve removed; final module build has no compiler warnings. ARM64 initramfs SSH check passed under QEMU.
host_validation.known_warning: Pre-existing depmod modules.builtin.modinfo metadata warning in initramfs build

live_readback.off_state_change: Requested level 51 while blank; actual_brightness stayed 0 until full wake, then 51

migration: systemd-backlight restored old binary value 1, clamped to 12. Reset current and saved brightness to 86 once. New installations start with driver default 86.

physical_validation.seven_step_ramp: User: Brightness increases; colours stay correct. Clean two-round sweep completed; an earlier missed/overlapping replay was stopped and is not used as evidence.
physical_validation.dim_and_full_wake: User: Both wakes look correct and steady. Levels 17 (20 nominal nit) and 255 (360 nominal nit); actual_brightness matched before and after each wake.
physical_validation.recovery: User: Colours, wake and filesystem button all work. Fresh recovery build #14 at level 86; log records off, on, deliberate Check filesystem action; root reports clean.
physical_validation.scope: No separate assertion about accidental wake actions from this combined test; user was asked to tap the button deliberately after waking.

limits: Nits are Samsung table targets, not measured with a luminance meter.
Room-temperature voltage table only; low-temperature ELVSS selection and HBM are not implemented.
No claim of individual physical validation for all 256 levels.
Instant battery current readings from a one-second sweep are not a power-efficiency measurement.

installed.boot_and_recovery: Both flushed/readback hash verified; both booted build #14
installed.final_state: Debian running, saved/current/applied brightness 86, screen service enabled and active, no failed units
installed.charge_state: Automatic, SDP 500 mA, health Good, 69%, battery 21.9 C / charger board 26.3 C. Boot-time net current sample -85.4 mA is not a steady-state charging measurement.
